rec.name: CRO | Rich Text Section (Headline, Subheadline, Text & Button)
rec.status: Built — delivered, documented (ticket still marked In Progress)

what.text: A standalone, reusable Shopify section called "CRO | Rich text" for brand story, USP or quote copy. It combines a headline, a subheadline, a body text block and a CTA button. Colors, fonts, alignment, sizes and the button are all editable. The layout can be stacked (centered, 'Showcase' style, e.g. a brand logo, small caps tagline and large quote) or side by side (headline and button on the left, body text on the right, 'Concept' style). The delivered code also includes an optional image/logo block, text transform, line-height, letter-spacing, mobile-specific overrides, max-width and padding.

why.text: Clear, well-structured brand and value copy builds trust and communicates the USP right where visitors land. Typographic hierarchy (big headline, then subheadline, then body) guides the eye and makes the message scannable. The CTA button after the story turns reading attention into a click. Because every style is editable, CRO teams can test message, tone and CTA wording without developer work.

how.text: Add the section file (ed-cro-rich-text.liquid) to the theme. It uses block types: image, subheading, heading, content and button. Style settings are output as CSS variables scoped to #shopify-section-{{ section.id }}. Color settings fall back to theme colors when transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0)). Custom fonts load via @font-face from the font_picker. The side-by-side layout is a CSS grid (3fr 4fr, 60px gap at 768px+, 120px gap and padding at 1180px+). The stacked layout is the default. Merchants add the section in the theme editor and add and order the blocks. Bold, italic and underline in text are handled via rich text (a highlighted-heading style is also in the CSS). Desktop and mobile visibility classes (cro_richtext-hide-desktop, cro_richtext-hide-mobile) are included. The developer states it works in any Shopify theme.

items: Section text color (falls back to theme color)
Headline: text, color, font family, alignment (left/center/right), font size, line height, letter spacing, text transform, spacing, optional max-width, mobile overrides
Subheadline: text, color, font, alignment, size, line height, letter spacing, text transform, spacing, mobile overrides
Body text: rich text with bold/italic/underline, color, font, size, alignment, line height, spacing, optional max-width, mobile overrides
Button: label, link, background color, text color, shape (rectangular/rounded), alignment (left/center/right, separate for mobile)
Hide on desktop / hide on mobile

dependencies.text: No metafield needed. Ticket field 'MF/N' suggests no metafield is required. The code relies on theme button classes (.button--primary / .button--secondary) and theme color settings (settings.heading_color, settings.text_color, settings.background). Custom fonts use the Shopify font_picker. Compatibility with other themes was claimed by the developer but depends on those classes and variables. The code file is truncated at the highlighted-heading CSS, so the full Liquid schema is not visible.

items: Scroll depth to and past the section
Bounce rate / engagement on the landing page
Click-through to story, collection or product pages
Conversion rate by variant (copy, layout, CTA wording)
